claim: §13.2 binds three base bars to V12's statistics, each "0": (T120-3) "no withheld thing appears in a suggestion, a count, a glow, a pin, a ghost pin, a gap outline or a legend chip (`find.leaks` 0)"; (T120-4) "the chips survive every band and layer change and every commit, advance, undo, redo, regenerate, load and migration, re-evaluated at once, and a chip whose last match goes stays in the set at count 0, dark (`find.held` 0)"; (T122-2) each look "exactly in its condition's weeks … and never for a condition the viewer's key withholds (DR44's admission) (`crisis.weeks` 0)". V12 defines them narrower — the metric registry (l. 1205) counts for `find.leaks` "the suggestions, counts, glows, pins and ghost pins naming a withheld entity" (no gap outline, no legend chip) and for `find.held` a step script of "band and layer changes, commits, an advance and an undo" (no redo, regenerate, load or migration, and no count-0 chip); §3.15.10's T120-4 bullet (l. 2621) is headed "every commit, advance and undo"; `crisis.weeks` (l. 1208; §3.15.12's T122-2 bullet, l. 2684) counts only weeks against [`sinceWeek`, `untilWeek`), never a withheld condition's look. T-V12-52's statistics measure T120-3 and T120-4 and T-V12-54 takes T122-2 on these measures, so a leak through a gap outline, a chip lost at a migration or a withheld look drawn passes the bar.
required_change: The metric registry's row (l. 1205) reads "… under a player view on the knowledge canary fixture, the suggestions, counts, glows, pins, ghost pins, gap outlines and legend chips naming a withheld entity; over a step script of band and layer changes, commits — one removing a chip's last match among them —, an advance, an undo, a redo, a regenerate, a save and load and a migration, the steps whose chip set changed or whose matches differ from a fresh evaluation there, and a chip whose last match went counted unless it stays at count 0, dark; …"; §3.15.10's T120-3 and T120-4 bullets read the same (T120-4's head "every band and layer change and every commit, advance, undo, redo, regenerate, load and migration"); the `crisis.weeks` row (l. 1208) and §3.15.12's T122-2 bullet add "and, under a player view whose key withholds a condition, every look of it drawn counted as a mismatched week (DR44's admission)"; T-V12-52 adds "a planted gap outline on the canary's district fails `find.leaks`, a chip dropped by a migration fails `find.held`" and T-V12-54 "a planted look of a condition the `public` key withholds fails `crisis.weeks`".
